title: Woolworths Ltd - proposed acquisition of Cresthaven Cellars

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Woolworths is proposing to acquire the fixtures and retail off-licence for a take-away packaged liquor store in Bateau Bay, NSW, known as Cresthaven Cellars.
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was considered in the context of the following markets: - the local (Bateau Bay) market for the retail sale of liquor for off-premises consumption; and - the NSW market for the wholesale supply of packaged liquor for subsequent sale in the retail market for liquor for off-premises consumption.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 7 March 2008, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - In relation to the local (Bateau Bay) market, Woolworths had no existing presence in the local area (within a 3-5 kilometer radius) and would face significant competition from both Liquorland and other independently owned retail outlets; and - In relation to the NSW wholesale market, the ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to significantly change the market dynamics between Woolworths and other liquor wholesalers.
